label: RnlAB system
definition: A phage defense system in which an organism possesses a genome-encoded RnlAB toxin-antitoxin locus represented by DefenseFinder as a two-profile model requiring RnlAB__RnlA and RnlAB__RnlB.
observations: RnlAB branch under phage defense system; distinct from the individual RnlA RNase LS toxin, the RnlB antitoxin, RNase LS activity, wild-type T4 evasion through Dmd, the RnlAB__RnlA and RnlAB__RnlB HMM profiles, source database rows naming one RnlAB model, and other phage-defense systems.
